  table with rows; "Download this view" serves the compartment CSV; each

- **O4** — act on a gap: an absence/gap chip resolves to

  closing condition, the request/records template and the operator-named
  submission channel (D-K11-4). When a reached gap task carries no
  draft, the spec finds a draft-bearing task from the research queue —
  it never invents one.
